title: ACM Launchpad
shortDesc: Our flagship inaugural event welcoming the new batch to the ACM VJIT chapter — featuring a freshmen ideathon to spark innovation from day one.
fullDesc:
ACM Launchpad was our flagship inaugural event that officially welcomed the new batch of CSE(AI&ML) students into the ACM VJIT family. The event began with an electrifying orientation session where chapter leads introduced the vision, mission, and opportunities that ACM VJIT offers throughout the year.

The highlight of the day was an introductory Ideathon where freshmen, many attending their very first college event, were challenged to brainstorm tech-driven solutions for real campus problems. Teams presented their ideas with raw enthusiasm, and the energy in the auditorium was absolutely electric.

With hundreds of new minds joining our community, ACM Launchpad set the tone for a year of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

title: Build & Deploy $5,000 3D Animated Website
shortDesc: Learn to build and deploy a $5,000-worth 3D animated website in one day using Google Flow, Google Antigravity, Google Stitch, and modern deployment tools.
fullDesc:
Ready to build websites that clients pay $5,000+ for? Join us for the most ambitious workshop ACM VJIT has ever hosted — a full-day, hands-on deep dive into creating stunning 3D animated websites from scratch.

What you'll learn:
• 3D Web Design with Google Flow — Create breathtaking 3D scenes and animations directly in your browser.
• AI-Powered Development with Google Antigravity — Leverage the most advanced AI coding assistant to write production-grade code at lightning speed.
• Component Stitching with Google Stitch — Seamlessly combine UI components and 3D assets into cohesive, professional layouts.
• External UI Libraries — Master premium component libraries that make your sites look world-class.
• Deploy Like a Pro — Push your finished site live using GitHub and Vercel in minutes.

By the end of this workshop, you'll walk out with a fully deployed, portfolio-worthy 3D animated website that you built yourself. No prior 3D experience required — just bring your laptop and your ambition.
